name: Potis Edge Battery
tagline: Stackable 48 V home battery, from 4.8 kWh to 19.2 kWh per stack.
summary: The Potis Edge (iPotisEdge ALOE series) is a stackable home battery built from 4.8 kWh packs. One stack takes up to four packs, and up to 24 packs can run in parallel.
It is rated IP65 and has a quick-plug design for easier transport and installation.

image.alt: Potis Edge Battery stackable home battery

highlights.title: Quick-plug design
highlights.text: Packs connect with a quick plug for easier transport and installation.

highlights.title: Triple protection
highlights.text: Three layers of protection keep the battery pack operating safely.

highlights.title: Compact and durable
highlights.text: A space-saving stack that is built to last.

highlights.title: Low power mode
highlights.text: The system drops into a low power mode when it is idle.

highlights.title: Room to grow
highlights.text: Stack up to four packs, and connect up to 24 packs in parallel.
